title: FireFlame Materials
description: The Custom Fire Ore With Custom Items (more updates coming soon!)
body:
# FireMaterials

This a plugin that adds custom blocks and items to minecraft have you ever heard about Items called Fire in Minecraft exept Fire Charge Fire and Lava if you added this mod to your mineraft this will add Fire Appels, Fire Ingot, Fire Block , Fire Ore, Fire Sword items and more coming soon! with more updates.
